screen.title: Calendar sync
screen.subtitle: Keep MeetingGuard in step with Google Calendar and the calendars on this phone.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.description: Two-way sync with your primary Google Calendar. Meetings you create here appear in Google Calendar (with invitations for participants), and your Google events get MeetingGuard alerts.
google.permissionNeededHint: MeetingGuard no longer has access to your Google Calendar. Grant access again to keep syncing.
google.firstSyncSummary: Imported {{created}} events and sent {{pushed}} meetings to Google Calendar.
google.firstSyncFailed: Connected, but the first sync did not finish: {{error}} MeetingGuard will try again automatically.
google.scopeDenied: Calendar access was not granted. You can connect again at any time.
google.disconnectMessage: Events imported from Google Calendar will be removed from MeetingGuard. Nothing is deleted from your Google Calendar.

device.title: Calendars on this phone
device.description: Import events from the calendars on this phone and, if you like, add your MeetingGuard meetings to one of them.

permission.denied: Calendar access is turned off for MeetingGuard.

device.empty: There are no calendars on this phone.

export.title: Add MeetingGuard meetings to
export.none: Don't add them to a phone calendar
export.hint: Only MeetingGuard meetings are added, without calendar reminders (MeetingGuard alerts you).

sync.googleResult: Google Calendar: {{created}} new, {{updated}} updated, {{removed}} removed, {{pushed}} sent to Google.
sync.deviceResult: Phone calendars: {{created}} new, {{updated}} updated, {{removed}} removed, {{pushed}} added to your phone calendar.

sync.failedGoogle_other: {{count}} changes could not be sent to Google Calendar.

sync.failedDevice_other: {{count}} meetings could not be added to your phone calendar.
sync.nothingToSync: Nothing to sync yet. Connect Google Calendar or choose calendars on this phone first.
